```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
source("/workspaces/starr-oncology-data-lake-arpah/src/R/all_function.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
source("/workspaces/starr-oncology-data-lake-arpah/src/nov_2026/_brain_tumor_metrics.R")
yaml_file_path <- "/workspaces/starr-oncology-data-lake-arpah/src/nov_2026/sql_params.yml"
sql_directory <- "/workspaces/starr-oncology-data-lake-arpah/src/sql_std_phi/common/brain_tumor"
```

```{r cohort sql, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(plotly)

# Unified color palette
color_palette <- c('#80CBC4', '#FFCC80', '#CE93D8', '#A5D6A7', '#90CAF9', '#F48FB1')

res_summary <- fetch_data_from_sql_file(file.path(sql_directory, "cohort_summary.sql"), yaml_file_path, release = "nov_2026")
res_demo <- fetch_data_from_sql_file(file.path(sql_directory, "demographics.sql"), yaml_file_path, release = "nov_2026")
cohort_size <- res_summary %>% filter(display_order == 1) %>% pull(patient_count)

age_levels <- c("0-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-18")

```

### Summary

The November 2026 oncology OMOP dataset (IRB76049) includes **`r format(cohort_size, big.mark = ",")`** unique patients who were 0 to 18 years old at their first qualifying brain tumor diagnosis (the index date).

### Demographic Summary

The demographic summaries use the pediatric brain tumor cohort as the denominator, with one row per patient within each characteristic.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Age at Index

```{r demo age, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
age_data <- res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Age at index")
patient_bar_chart(age_data, "category", "Unique Patients by Age at Index", color_palette[1],
                  order_levels = age_levels)
```

## Sex

```{r demo sex, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Sex"), "category",
                  "Unique Patients by Sex", color_palette[2])
```

## Race

```{r demo race, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Race"), "category",
                  "Unique Patients by Race", color_palette[3])
```

## Ethnicity

```{r demo ethnicity, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Ethnicity"), "category",
                  "Unique Patients by Ethnicity", color_palette[4])
```

## Summary Table

```{r demo table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_demo %>%
  select(characteristic, category, patient_count, percentage) %>%
  datatable(
    colnames = c("Characteristic", "Category", "Unique Patients", "% Patients"),
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = 'ftp'),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

:::
